# report-streams

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The report event streams: Error reports and Slow-op reports (the kinds whose `category` is error / slow-op), each fed every recorded report of its category — one event per occurrence, keyed by the report so its occurrences fold into one line of the supervisor's next message.
- Server:
  - Contributes:
    - `supervisor-event-stream` "error-reports"
    - `supervisor-event-stream` "slow-op-reports"
    - `report-recorded` "tasks.supervisor-roles.events.report-streams"
- Machine:
  - Uses: `tasks/supervisor-roles/events.publishSupervisorEvent`
  - Register: `defineJob('supervisor-events.report')`

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->
